## How to install

1. Download **Sottodesu-x.y.z.dmg** from the *Assets* list below.
2. Open it and double-click **Sottodesu**. Choose **Move to Applications** when it asks: it installs itself, ejects the installer and moves the download to the Trash.
3. Open Sottodesu from Applications and press **Sort**.

**No warning at all:** paste this into Terminal instead of using the disk image:

```
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lexeremin/Sottodesu/main/Scripts/install.sh)"
```

**If macOS says the app "cannot be opened":** click *Done*, open **System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security**, scroll to *Security* and click **Open Anyway**. You only do this once. ([Why?](https://github.com/lexeremin/Sottodesu/blob/main/README.md#opening-it-for-the-first-time))

**New:** automatic tidy-up schedules, a preview before sorting, and history search with per-file restore.

Requires macOS 15 or later. Available in English, Русский, 简体中文, 한국어, 日本語 and Français. Full guide: [README](https://github.com/lexeremin/Sottodesu#readme).
